result:
result: Two blocking findings. The root instruction change is not ready: the state-mode order leaves a dead end, and the finishing rule contradicts the final-report rule. Most other checks pass.
changed: none (read-only review; no shell in this role, so git state and the dist commit were not verified)
checks: none run. This role has no shell, and I used Read, Grep and Glob only.
blockers:
1. [packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/version-control.md:15-16 and packages/runtime/src/instructions/requirements.md:35] The diff moves the ownership signal ahead of the tracked-state signal. A repository the owner does not control that already tracks `.holyagent/` (beyond config.json) now gets `local`. `setStateMode` refuses that (packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts:880-885), and `vcs commit` refuses it (packages/runtime/src/vcs/commit.ts:147-158). Before the diff, that case selected `work`. No text says what to do after the refusal, and the refusal hint ("use the work mode") would put state into commits on a repository the owner does not control. Fix: in version-control.md line 15 and R-STATE, add that when git already tracks state there, the root asks the user through AskUserQuestion with a recommended default and records the answer in the Intent. This changes a rule, so it goes to the root.
2. [packages/runtime/src/instructions/claude-5.5/root/assignments.md:17; generated holyagent.md line 79] One bullet says both "Name each Unknown result and waived gate" and "The final report and PR text list only what needs the user ... plus skipped visual preferences". Unknown results and waived gates are not on the allowed list. Generated holyagent.md line 146 also requires unresolved threads and non-clean merge state in the final report, and those are not user decisions either. A root that follows the new sentence drops items the Unknown rule requires it to name. Fix: add "Unknown results, waived gates, and the PR's unresolved threads and merge state" to the allowed list in line 17, or move the requirement out of the sentence.
notes:
- Non-blocking, ride-along removed silently: assignments.md line 13 dropped "Non-blocking findings other than visual preference ride along when the writer is already repairing a blocker and get no review of their own." Nothing replaces it, so every non-blocking item now costs an extra repair and re-review round. Fix: restore that sentence in line 13. It is compatible with the finish round, which covers what the blocker repair does not fold in.
- Non-blocking, brief contradiction: generated holyagent.md line 102 tells specialists not to add unrequested "tests", "files" or "extra review rounds". The finish round in assignments.md line 13 and requirements.md line 30 asks for "checks that can be added" and a re-review. Fix: state in line 13 that the finish round's brief names its added checks as requested.
- Non-blocking, loop bound: the finish round is one round, so its leftovers go to the user. But a blocking finding raised by the finish round's re-review falls under "Blocking findings start a repair and a re-review" (line 13), which has no round cap. Only the visual loop is capped. Fix: say what a blocking finding from that re-review does, or cap it, as a root decision.
- Non-blocking, PR text: assignments.md line 17 says PR text lists "only what needs the user", but the PR-text rule (generated holyagent.md line 151) requires "what remains". Fix: scope the sentence to the final report, or let PR text keep what remains.
- Non-blocking, undefined scope: "edge cases" (requirements.md line 30; assignments.md line 13) has no criterion. The rubric only blocks on untested error paths. Fix: define it or drop it.
- Non-blocking, duplication against the writing bar: the three-round rule is restated in requirements.md lines 31 and 136, root/visual.md line 7 and roles/worker-visual/purpose.md line 1. The finish rule is restated in requirements.md line 30 and assignments.md lines 13 and 17. requirements.md line 31 is about 170 words. Fix: keep the round owner in one place and let the worker purpose name only the round in the Assignment.
- Visual loop, who counts: the root counts repair rounds (root/visual.md line 7, requirements.md line 31, worker purpose line 1, R-WVI line 136). The three-round cap is consistent. The CLI has no round field (no "round" in packages/runtime/src/domain), so the round number travels as free text in the Assignment criteria. That works if the brief names it.
- Dist verification: the diff file does not contain generated files. The worktree dist (packages/integrations/claude/dist/agents/holyagent.md lines 75, 79, 123-125; worker-visual.md line 15) already has the new text, so it was regenerated. Without git I could not confirm the dist is in commit be35f58. The main checkout's dist is still stale, which is expected for main.
- Size: the change adds about 190 words to the root set (requirements.md line 30, assignments.md lines 13 and 17). The Assignment names no expected size, so I did not check it against a target.
- Writing bar: the new text is positive, uses no capital-letter emphasis, is in US English, and has no placeholders.
- Consistent: the mergeability rule and "only blocking findings start a repair" (the "Only" was dropped, with the finish round as the stated exception); the unrequested-features rule ("named, not built"); the asking rules; the R-REVIEW and visual preference exclusion; and the phrases in packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts (line 246 "one more repair round" is in assignments.md line 13; line 352 "stop repairing a finding after round three" is in worker-visual purpose.md line 1).
